text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: SEV1 - inference-cluster-eu-west-1 - high 5xx rate detected (alert: a1f3c9). Multiple alerts in <1m, auto-rollup engaged.
PagerDuty: page delivered to on-call (Priya).
Sam R: seeing the same, lots of duplicate alerts from the autoscaler + inference queue.
Priya: acked. I'm on it. will take lead.
Jess L: @Priya do we have any customer-facing impact? any big customers throttled?
Sam R: quick snapshot — 5xx rate ~12% across frontend->model path for last 3m, spike started 00:02 UTC. Traffic not unusual, looks like an internal regress or KV cache evictions. customer errors: 2 customers show elevated failures (IDs redacted).
Priya: ok, triage plan — 1) confirm duplicate suppression/rollup so noise reduced 2) check autoscaler and pod restarts 3) if needed, scale pool and toggle fallback to variant-v2. @Jess L please stand by for CS ping.
Infra Bot: Duplicate alert rollup enabled: grouping 18 related alerts into rollup a1f3c9. Subsequent duplicate pages suppressed for 120s.
Sam R: logs tailing now. seeing repeated `kvcache eviction` in model-worker logs and OOM kill on one replica.
Priya: runbook step 3 -> check node oom and restart, step 6 -> apply temporary capacity boost. Sam can you run the commands below to bump pool?
Sam R: running.
Sam R: ```bash
# increase dedicated pool for inference-eu-west
rictl pool update --name inference-eu-west --min 6 --max 12 --burst 4
# verify pods
kubectl get pods -n redwood | grep model-worker
```
Sam R: pool update succeeded, new replicas scheduling.
Priya: good. also enable model variant fallback so requests route to variant-v2 if model-worker fails.
Jess L: pinging CS: "We detected a transient 5xx spike in EU West impacting some requests; engineering is actively mitigating. Will post update in 20m or earlier." :wave:
PagerDuty: Pager acknowledged by Priya at 00:06 UTC. Escalation suppressed.
Sam R: after new pods spin up, I'm still seeing occasional error bursts, likely warmup/kv cache cold misses. Error rate dropped to ~3.5% over last 2m.
Priya: good trend. Applying a short-term cache warming policy and increasing kv cache size on the workers. Sam, run the cache flag:```

sysctl -w dev.kv_cache.size=2048
```

Sam R: cache flag applied to nodes via infra job. logs show fewer evictions.
Priya: status update for timeline: root cause hypothesis = KV cache thrash + one pod OOM triggering cascade; symptom = alert fanout; mitigation = pool bump, restart OOM pod, increase kv cache, enable fallback model variant.
Jess L: CS notified customers A and B with mitigation ETA ~10m, they acknowledged.
Priya: monitoring — error rate now 1.1% and stable for 3m. Latency normal.
Sam R: I'm continuing a 15m watch. will post if regress.
Priya: leaving a note to tweak alert thresholds to avoid duplicate fanout next week, and add a guard in the autoscaler for transient OOM storms.
Infra Bot: Alert a1f3c9 auto-closed by rollup: incident resolved condition met (error rate <2% for 5m).
PagerDuty: Pager resolved by Priya at 00:32 UTC.
Jess L: thanks everyone — closing the PD incident after a brief postmortem doc. I will create a follow-up thread for runbook updates and threshold tuning. :memo:
Priya: thanks all.
Sam R: thx.
